quarterly_data.quarter: Lasertec results briefing Q&A: Fiscal Year Ended June 2026 1on1 FAQ (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company 1on1 FAQ, FY2026 (July 2025 - June 2026): sales were 104.8% of the JPY 220.0 billion forecast because tool acceptance was completed ahead of schedule and the yen was weaker than assumed (actual average 150 JPY/USD). ACTIS was 30.6% of sales and MATRICS 22.3%; semiconductor-related product sales were mask inspection <80%, blank inspection <15%, wafer inspection >5%. Gross margin was 59.2% (+0.3pts) and operating margin 45.7% (-3.2pts). Orders: ACTIS 26.1% and MATRICS 32.5% of the total; semiconductor-related product orders were mask inspection <90%, blank inspection >5%, wafer inspection <5%. The company says orders recovered as leading-edge (2nm and 3nm equivalent) capacity expanded, and it has generally passed on higher raw material and memory component costs through pricing, so the impact has been limited.
quarterly_data.figure: Gross margin 59.2%; operating margin 45.7%; ACTIS 30.6% of sales, MATRICS 22.3%; ACTIS 26.1% of orders, MATRICS 32.5%

quarterly_data.quarter: Lasertec results briefing Q&A: Fiscal Year Ended June 2026 1on1 FAQ (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company 1on1 FAQ, FY2027 (July 2026 - June 2027) forecast details: net profit JPY 90.0 billion (up JPY 12.5 billion); semiconductor-related products JPY 225 billion, of which mask inspection 90%, blank inspection >5%, wafer inspection <5%; services JPY 61.5 billion (up JPY 2.8 billion); other products JPY 3.5 billion; operating margin 43.1% (-2.5pts); R&D JPY 20.0 billion (6.9% of sales); capital expenditure JPY 5.7 billion (up JPY 3.3 billion); depreciation and amortization JPY 3.6 billion. The company expects record sales and profits as sales of mask inspection systems rise, driven primarily by ACTIS and MATRICS, following the FY2026 order recovery.
